title: 2012.08 - 'Old & new foundation constructions under Central Station Amsterdam', urban photo of construction activities, Fons Heijnsbroek (12101321055)
description: 2012 - photo of a construction worker underground, in rebuilding and foundation works under the brick building of Central Station Amsterdam. The reconstruction of the brick late 19th century built foundations, now combined with new early-21st century concrete foundations. They support together now the 19th-century station building. Photography of construction activities and renovation works of the old Central Station building in Amsterdam city, The Netherlands; a geo-tagged and free download image in the public domain / Commons - CC0 photo by Dutch photographer Fons Heijnsbroek, Summer 2012.
author: Fons Heijnsbroek from Amsterdam, Netherlands
